skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Bard by the Lake
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard by the Lake. Attire Cantabile wore during her lakeside holiday. The white of the dress is in perfect harmony with the natural environment, creating a tranquil, dream-like ambience.
skins.quote: As Cantabile's slender fingers pluck at the strings, a melodious song begins to play across the lake. Her holiday is not a long one, but at the very least, at this very moment, she wants to forget it all, and allow herself to soak in the tranquility.

skins.name: Illumination That of Daylights
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Illumination That of Daylights. Made by Lungmen tailors. The gauze lining at the hem softens the lines, as does the matching white shawl.
skins.quote: Coolness of spring, touching the flames of life; warm evening breeze, touching the cheek's silver flower.
